items.title: matrix • (February 17th 2023)
items.description:
This how it is when you in the matrix. 

I’m alone today. 

I thought too hard about whether or not I should be honest with *deleted* about my art work. What grounds do I set? What rules? I make this stuff from pain and everyone around me keeps asking me for a taste. 

- they don’t know any better and neither would I. So I get it. But it’s hard because I’ve been stabbed in the past. Emotionally. 

- Same level of violence when you consider who the person that is attacking. 

My instincts are kicking up and I seek solace in isolation. 

Stretching to Nirvana.

I made a soundscape back in 2019 for a class, the goal was to create something using the every day that reflects the every day - damn this sounds useless writing about it.

items.title: (1) BreakDown of F.I.O.
items.description:
It's been difficult -DELETED- but I've been trying. I can't do everything. Feels like school is a waste of time. But I'm luckier than anyone I know. Stuck in the trenches but out of the war.

Anyway, here's a breakdown of the first fuck around that I posted. I know people like what I do but I have no control over what I make and it upsets me. I feel like my emotional state is still not mine like the music I make is still not mine. I feel what I want to do is out of reach and asking for help is out of the question. Ima rap all these words one day I swear.

items.title: e(MOTION)
items.description:
The body is a kingdom. The body is a dominion ruled over by your benevolence or malice. Love is gonna get you killed. Pride does what it will. I’m taking big steps away from fear. Jazz is in the air and in here. I’m laughing. Not at myself no longer. Not at my pain no longer. To understand you had to be there. But I can tell you I’m a person. Seedling making greenery his surroundings! Passion from poison makes oceans and it’s me at sea! Me, Ángel. Me, still in disbelief!

Maybe your vision decayed by sights of today. I might take your life while I fight grief, fight strife, fight me. These chains make for heavy training. Succumb as a slave or be damned just with the rest. Walls can't kill you. Homes do. Complacent Bitch.

Sample: You Will Never Find Another Lover Like Mine - In Essence

items.title: M.I.A.
items.description:
I write right now to let you know that you’re against me. You’re swooned and I’m stuck because of my incapableness. I’m among a desert of incapables, though. You’re swooned by the momentary benefits but you will never be as happy as you can be with chains. It only weakens you. I am depressed and trying to ignore your drama and your family’s. They come at me faster than you’ll remember. How’s the cat? Did you ever finish the essays? Was it all just a waste of time. Am I dumb for sitting here? Am I stupid?

Do you harbor hate because they’re days where I feel something in my chest? I look for my own words but inside grows content. Other’s come out. Respect. Thanks. Now sign that check right next to my life thread so I can feel better with my time given. I have no control over my life nor how I am organized. A light skin spic without even the language to become distinct. Thanks for that also. Is the old lady doing those new old same things? I can’t expect ancient dogs to learn new tricks but I would think humans had more capableness.

Turns out we don’t. Let me have a few laughs and maybe a -DELETED- so I won’t feel no more. Ripped down into the abyss of populace where we most are. Noise.

🧠STORY - dead end¡

When I think how to describe the shit I do I think like, I dunno. I heard someone say it’s like setting dust on fire. Comes from my chest and my head and it burns for as long as I groove. items.title: G.o.G.0.
items.description:
early child(Hood) inspired

My reality’s losing my grip or I’m losing a hold of my head the other or the one. I’m not sure of anything anymore but I just know that my body can’t keep up with the speed at which I’m going. I can’t even -DELETED- without turning off everything in that room including myself. I was raised to be always on and I think I’ve subconsciously divided the good with the bad parts of myself like a good Christian. Yet it’s not a solution to things.

I remember reading in an overbearing test a philosophy question. Something about the hair follicles of the mind called thoughts. The question was whether or not it is sound to pluck them from our heads. I don’t think that’s how the mind works. I think the mind does what it does and we have partial autonomy over what our body does because of it. I’m splintered because I’m a consequence of two 20th century coups turned wrong because they were successful. I was never supposed to be born and yet I feel so un-respected because of the adversity I had faced at even leaving my mothers womb and even further my family at surviving. My -DELETED- was a beggar. My -DELETED- was a cleaning lady. I never met one of them. And the other swings faster than swings in a hurricane. I’m annoyed at the double life I live. In my mind and outside. They tell us the world favors adversity but we praise those who haven’t shook hands with their locked doors. I’m trapped behind mine every day and I pray I make it out with my light intact. This stuff really helps. I hope you can hear that.

Debbie Taylor - I Dont Wanna Leave You.
-Spider-Man 1967-

(I still don’t).

items.title: AFFA!R
items.description:
I'm playin around in the dirt here. Making as much noise as possible. Nobody looks. Nobody looks do they. Well, I’ll make a bigger mess. One that ruins the pretty pictures that I wanted to make. I gotta get their attention. My voice can’t be stolen so I gotta use my hands. My hands always hurt so now I gotta use my head. My head is just a tool now and that’s gotta be okay. I gotta be okay. That’s okay, how not okay I am. Keep going keep going. Keep folding keep folding. Origami is my middle name after all. I wonder if I'm gonna make it. I wonder if they’re gonna lift me or laugh. Who cares. My ears are all that matter. My sounds are all that matter. They wanna take from me because they got robbed. Was I born to be robbed?

TheY enJoy mE wheN I”m sAd. They EnjOy me wHen I’m lost. I’m dying in this -DELETED-.

I’m not scared anymore.
